title: Alexander Springs 4 Hour Guided Kayak/ Swim/ Snorkel Adventure
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Your native owner or operator has been operating tours on Silver River and many other Florida waterways for 20 years. He is a UF master naturalist and has dedicated his life to bringing awareness and smiles to people's faces. We have a great team of professional guides that love what they do & it shows. We are not just an outfitter; we convey the power of nature, for happiness, healing, and peace to all who seek it. To us, paddling in nature is a lifestyle, and one that brings attention to detail, quality equipment, and excellent, uncompromised service.
